text.p: Dawson Science Corp said Friday that it estimates earnings of $0.20 a share on $3 million profits for the third quarter ending September 30, 1997.
In a press release, the company also said it estimates earnings of $0.30 a share on $6 million in profits the fourth quarter.
Dawson that with all financing in place and 5,000 more vehicles on the road, the it estimates a profit of $50 million, or $1.67 per share.
According to the company, this growth is made possible by recent securing of key licenses and permits to rent cars, operate taxi cabs and operate cargo trucks in major cities in China.
The company said that these projections are based on a recent Price Waterhouse audit and an analysis by a division of the Chinese government, as well as company goals.
Results from previous periods were not immediately avialable. A company spokeswoman was not available.
